definition: To limit the rate at which a function is invoked, ensuring it only runs after a specified period of inactivity to avoid excessive calls.
example: We debounce the input event handler to prevent sending an API request on every keystroke, triggering it only after the user stops typing for 300ms.

definition: To limit the rate at which a function is executed by ensuring it only runs after a specified delay following the last trigger, commonly used to handle noisy input like rapid clicks or keystrokes.
example: We debounced the search input so that the API call is only made 300ms after the user stops typing.
